messages:
olivia: quick check — anyone have the dashboards/traces for the 02:12–02:30 UTC 5xx spike last night? Paged ops, needs some trace samples and guidance on whether to relax the alert window for noisy client-side errors.

sam: put the key links here: grafana - https://grafana.redwood.com/d/errors?panelId=7&from=now-1d&to=now , tempo traces - https://tempo.redwood/trace?service=api&from=2026-03-16T02:00:00Z&to=2026-03-16T02:40:00Z .

sam: quick Loki example to get raw proxy logs around spike:
```
{app=\"edge-proxy\"} |= \"status=502\" | json | line_format \"{http.path} {status} {request_id}\"
```

maya: thanks — do we think this is a backend overload or external (CDN/client) retry storm? Ops noted most requests were failing with upstream timeouts.

sam: initial signal points to a small set of routes: `/v1/stream`, `/api/reply` — see the "Errors by route" panel in that grafana dashboard. Traces show many `upstream request timeout` and `502 from upstream`. Also noticed a deploy at 02:05 (see deploy-bot).

deploy-bot: deploy service/api @release/2026.03.16-02 completed by ci-bot — 2026-03-16T02:05:12Z :rocket:

leo: for alert tuning, we usually widen the evaluation window before changing thresholds. Suggest: change the firing window from 3m to 5m and add a route filter for noisy client paths. Example prometheus rule snippet we use: 
```
- alert: High5xxRate
  expr: (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"api\",status=~\"5..\"}[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"api\"}[5m])) by (route)) > 0.01
  for: 5m
```

sam: ^^ agree. Also add `route=~"^/(v1|api)/"` to focus on product endpoints if you want to ignore static/CDN noise.

olivia: one more — ops wants to backfill SLO data for the 01:30–03:00 window to see impact on weekly burn. How do I run the backfill?

leo: run the backfill tool: 
```
./bin/slo-backfill --service=api --start=2026-03-16T01:30:00Z --end=2026-03-16T03:00:00Z --output=workdir/backfill-2026-03-16.json
```
Docs: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/slo-backfill (includes dry-run flag and retention notes).

maya: I'm going to mute the noisy CDN route in alerts for 24h and monitor. Will post results. :eyes:

olivia: thanks all — assigning follow-up to @sam to check upstream cluster health during that window and confirm if rollback was needed.

sam: on it, will post a short postmortem if we need to change alerting or runbook.
